questions.prompt: Residuals (du, dv): (2, 0), (0, 0), (0, 2), (2, 2). Give the RMS in pixels (precision 0.01).
f = 1000 px, k1 = -0.05, k2 = 0. How many pixels does a point at normalised radius 0.8 shift (f*r*|k1|*r^2)? (precision 0.1)
Distort x = 0.5, y = 0 with k1 = -0.2, k2 = 0, then project with f = 400, cx = 320. What is u? (precision 0.1)
A 7x10-corner board is seen in 8 views. How many scalar residuals does the reprojection objective have? (integer)
Model: 4 intrinsics, 3 radial coefficients and 6 pose values for each of 10 views. How many parameters? (integer)
Corner positions have independent noise of 0.25 px per axis and the model is correct. About what RMS reprojection error should you expect (sigma*sqrt(2))? (precision 0.01)
Undistortion by fixed-point iteration: xd = 0.45, y = 0, k1 = -0.2, start at x = xd. What is x after one iteration (x = xd / (1 + k1 r^2) with the current x)? (precision 0.001)
You tune a distortion coefficient until the error on your 'test' images is lowest, then report that error as the calibration quality. What went wrong?
options: The coefficient is unitless, so it cannot be tuned on image data
RMS was the wrong metric; a mean of the lengths should be reported
Nothing: test images are exactly what should be used to tune coefficients
Leakage: the test images influenced the fit, so the number is optimistic
questions.explanation: Held-out data must not influence the fit or the model selection.

questions.prompt: Adding k2 to a model fitted on the same data. What can you say about the training RMS?
options: It must decrease strictly, because every new parameter fits some noise
It cannot increase (nested model), but held-out error may worsen
It is always better on held-out data too, since the model is richer
It stays identical, because k2 is only used at the image corners
questions.explanation: More parameters fit at least as well on the same data.

questions.prompt: Residual vectors from a calibration point radially outward and grow toward the image corners. What does this suggest?
options: A missing or insufficient radial distortion term in the model
Rolling shutter, which skews the residuals along the scan direction
Gaussian noise on the corners, which has no spatial structure
A wrong principal point only, which shifts all residuals the same way
questions.explanation: Structured radial residuals are a model error, not noise.

questions.prompt: Plan the image set for calibrating a 1280x720 wide-angle camera: how many images, which poses, what coverage, and when do you re-shoot?
rubric: About 15-25 images with tilts up to 45 degrees and several distances.
Corners and edges of the image covered; sharp, fixed focus.
Re-shoot if held-out RMS is much larger than training RMS or parameters change between sessions.
